about: Every Vercel project this repository deploys to (.github/workflows/deploy.yml, through scripts/deploy/deploy-targets.mjs), and the branch each one follows. A deployment that is live gets every green Check of a push to its branch, built in CI and uploaded prebuilt. The content release job compiles with main's code, so it publishes a release only when each live deployment of main serves a /build-info.json naming the code the release was compiled from (scripts/content/deploy-gate.mjs); a deployment of another branch runs other code by design and is not asked. One that is not live yet gets nothing automatically: a manual Deploy run with preview ticked uploads a preview to its project, which moves none of its domains. tokenSecret names the GitHub secret holding a Vercel token for that team. vercel.json turns Vercel's own Git deployments off: they build without the Check, and cannot say which commit they are.
